title: Láctea S.A. — WordPress corporate site
summary: Institutional site for Láctea S.A., a bovine reproductive biotechnology lab in Virú, Peru. Built on WordPress with a custom 'sembryo' theme, focused on local SEO, contact conversion, and a nationwide distributor network.
context: Láctea S.A. is Peru's first reproductive biotechnology lab, dedicated to bovine in-vitro production. The public site communicates services (OPU-IVF, embryo transfer, microbiology lab, internships), products (animal genetics, semen, Mumu dairy, Bravio meat) and a nationwide distributor network. Built on WordPress with a custom theme called 'sembryo', focused on local SEO, editorial clarity, and conversion via WhatsApp and a contact form.
challenges: Model a mixed domain (biotechnology + product catalog + distributor network) into a clear page hierarchy for SEO.
Build a custom theme that loads fast on field-mobile connections without sacrificing the visual gallery.
Wire the contact form, the floating WhatsApp button, and the distributor page into an operational regional map.
Keep the back-office simple enough that Láctea's team can update services, products, and news without depending on a developer.
approach: WordPress with a custom 'sembryo' theme: hand-rolled template structure, no commercial theme lock-in.
Reusable blocks and admin-editable pages (services, products, news, distributors) on top of the native editor.
jQuery powering the front-end interactive components (banner, maps, form) with progressive enhancement.
SweetAlert for form submissions and WhatsApp handoff without page reloads.
Lean editorial workflows so the team can publish content without touching the repository.
outcomes: lactea.com.pe in production with sections the in-house team can update.
Visible catalog of services and products with clear routes from local SEO.
Contact form and WhatsApp CTA integrated and operational.
Distributors page with a referential map of Peru.
